key_insight: MaRDI Open Interfaces reduces the integration burden between computational experiments and nonlinear optimization solvers by providing a common interface layer.
engineering_relevance: This improves interoperability, making it easier to swap, benchmark, and bind numerical solvers without rewriting experiment code.
method: Updated software package with a new nonlinear optimization interface
Supports computational experiments by standardizing solver access
Demonstrated on training physics-informed neural networks for viscous Burgers' equation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a demonstration on optimization-based experiments for physics-informed neural networks, but does not provide quantitative benchmark results.
watch_item: Utility depends on how well the interface covers solver-specific features and whether adapting legacy codes still requires nontrivial integration work.
paper_title: Software package MaRDI Open Interfaces for improved interoperability in numerical optimization
